# (zzz) The 35 fixed chests of the stages 1 to 10: effect of the content and delay opening -> pickup (generated by tools/gen_chest_scenario.py,

until front_mode == MODES['TITLE'] max 2000
wait 10
tap C

tap START

tap RIGHT
tap RIGHT
tap B
until game.stage == 1 and game.room == 2 max 300
poke Enemies_god 1

until ram8("vk_candles+119") == 0 max 200
set t0 frame
until ram8("vk_candles+321") == 2 max 200
set dt frame - t0
wait 2
expect ram8("vk_candles+118") == 5 # stage 1 room 2: content 02 taken
expect 72 <= dt <= 76 # delay opening -> pickup (MSX: sound 11 -> sound 12 in 73 frames)
